scope_statement: Describe a reproducible literature review and framework development process for analyzing platform mechanisms and operationalizing case metrics.
must_cover: Define precise search terms for platform economics and mechanisms
Set transparent inclusion and exclusion criteria tied to mechanisms
Extract evidence on network effects, multi-homing, governance, pricing
Develop a compact, comparable analysis framework across platforms
Operationalize dimensions using publicly available metrics and documents
Select a case platform with sufficient public data for analysis
should_cover: Document databases, search strings, and screening flow
Justify temporal and language coverage choices
Pilot the framework on a sample case to refine measures
Assess source quality and methodological rigor
Ensure reproducibility by archiving search results and protocols
must_avoid: Unrelated platform theories not used in framework
Anecdotal blog posts without empirical support
main_query: structured literature review platform markets network effects multi-homing governance monetization operationalization
facet_queries: Two-sided market foundational definitions and taxonomy
Positive and negative network effects empirical measures
Multi-homing incidence and measurement across platforms
Platform governance: rules, ranking, and access studies
Switching costs and user lock-in empirical indicators
Monetization models: fees, commissions, pricing structures
Competition dynamics and winner-takes-most empirical evidence
Operationalization using public data: downloads, fees, market share
Case studies: Airbnb Uber eBay app stores comparative
Selection and exclusion criteria transparency in reviews
Methodological rigor and source quality assessment frameworks
Framework validation and pilot case applications
scoring_guidance: Score sources by relevance to defined mechanisms (40%), empirical rigor (25%), availability of public data for operationalization (15%), recency and citation impact (10%), and transparency/reproducibility (10%). Prefer sources providing measurable indicators or case data.
